name: Gross dilemmas
description: Revolting either-ors where neither option is any good.

guarradas-beberte-de-un-trago-un-vaso-de.text: Down a glass of oil or a glass of vinegar in one go?

guarradas-que-prefieres-que-te-hagan-enc.text: Would you rather get pooped on or puked on?

guarradas-con-que-cargas-para-siempre.text: Which one do you live with forever?

guarradas-beber-leche-caducada-en-grumos.text: Drink lumpy expired milk or eat rotten eggs?

guarradas-limpiarte-con-papel-higienico-.text: Wipe with used toilet paper or with nothing at all?

guarradas-que-se-te-meta-una-cucaracha-e.text: A cockroach crawling into your ear or a spider up your nose?

guarradas-comer-un-plato-de-mocos-o-bebe.text: Eat a plate of snot or drink a glass of drool?
